item.title: China’s BYD Displaces Tesla as the Global Leader of EVs
item.description: BYD’s rise reflects China’s scale, pricing power, and policy coherence, while Tesla’s slowdown exposes how US political backlash is reshaping the global EV race. China’s BYD has overtaken Elon Musk’s Tesla as the world’s biggest seller of electric vehicles (EVs), marking the first time it has outpaced its American rival in annual sales. item.title: Russia Delivered Few, If Any, Su-57s in 2025
